The third "Tour of Duty" of [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] takes place between the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Leia Organa]] and the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], that is to say during {{Film|4}}. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of the movie to 0 BBY, and more precisely to 35:3 GrS.
